summary: A member takes responsibility for one section of a long bill alongside a colleague from the other party.
realLife: Humphrey and Kuchel organized bipartisan teams for the separate titles of the civil rights bill.
gates: The bill has multiple titles and support across parties.
inGame: needs: a title-by-title assignment roster linking members of each party to the same bill.

turns.what: A member covers two titles until a counterpart joins.
turns.pulledBy: One subject has an expert from only one caucus.
turns.writesBack: The assignment roster shows a temporary double duty.

turns.what: A pair trades titles after a technical question comes up.
turns.pulledBy: Another pair includes a member who worked on that provision.
turns.writesBack: The next briefing goes to the newly assigned pair.
